description: One U.S.-listed stock, ETF or fund's dividend record: forward yield, annual dividend, payout frequency, payout ratio, years of consecutive increases, A-F dividend safety grade, next ex-dividend and pay dates, fair value estimate and its dividend raises and cuts, newest first. Use for questions like "does Coca-Cola pay a dividend", "when is O's next ex-dividend date" or "has PepsiCo ever cut its dividend".

history_limit.description: How many raises and cuts to return, newest first (0-100).

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, such as KO, O, SCHD or JEPQ.

name: get_dividend_profile
title: Dividend profile for a ticker
